up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for dapagliflozin (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL429910) and any of its salt forms, i.e., all molecules whose parent is dapagliflozin according to the molecule_hierarchy table, against the target sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3884). For each record, include the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, canonical SMILES from compound_structures, IC50 standard value, standard units, standard relation, pchembl_value if available, assay description, assay type (e.g., B, F), target organism, PubMed ID, and DOI. Only include records where the standard_type is 'IC50' and the target is identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3884.
sql:
WITH dapa_molregno AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL429910'
),
dapa_and_salts AS (
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN dapa_molregno d ON mh.parent_molregno = d.molregno
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.standard_value AS ic50_standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.pchembl_value,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    ass.assay_type,
    td.organism AS target_organism,
    d.pubmed_id,
    d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN dapa_and_salts s ON a.molregno = s.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3884';
